title: Conga Brava credits
summary: Tizol wrote Conga Brava alone and Duke arranged and recorded it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: How did 'Conga Brava' come about? Did you write that alone?
And did Duke arrange it like he did 'Caravan'?
Yeah, he arranged it himself, yes, Duke.
But did you write it by yourself? Did you write it alone or did you write it with Duke?
Well, that's one of those things, you know? I wrote it myself. But he did the arrangement and recorded it.
